Permanent Holiday Lights Install Lincoln & Omaha, NE | Apogee Lawns

Permanent Christmas lights are an innovative lighting solution designed to be installed once and used year-round. Unlike traditional holiday lights that need to be set up and taken down annually, permanent holiday lights are discreetly installed along the eaves of your home and controlled via an app, allowing you to customize colors, patterns, and schedules. This modern approach to holiday lighting saves time, enhances safety, and offers flexibility for every season and occasion.
More than just for holidays. You can make every day special like birthdays, parties, game day and more by creating your own custom lighting sequences.
Designed for ease of use, the EverLights app makes creating custom lighting designs and scheduling for holidays a snap.
Our professional, highly-skilled technicians will install your lights to our exacting standards. No more ladders or paying every year to have your lights put up.

Our lights are as tough as they are beautiful. Designed to withstand any weather—rain, snow, or shine—EverLights are made to last. With an IP67 waterproof rating, you can trust that your lights will keep shining brightly no matter what Mother Nature throws at them.

Change colors, create patterns, and set schedules with just a few taps. Whether you want to highlight your home with accent lighting, switch to warm white for a cozy feel, or experiment with seasonal colors, it’s all at your fingertips.

Good news for your electric bill! EverLights uses energy-efficient LED lights that consume far less power than traditional lights. That means you can enjoy all the beauty without the guilt of a high energy bill.
##H3## Installation Available for Homes & Businesses in Lincoln, Omaha & Surrounding Areas in Nebraska

Permanent holiday lights (also called permanent Christmas lights or year-round accent lights) are professional-grade LED lighting systems that are installed once along the eaves of your home and then used every day of the year. Unlike traditional string lights you hang and take down annually, EverLights are discreet during the day and controlled from your phone. You can instantly change colors, patterns, and schedules for holidays, birthdays, game days, parties, or just everyday accent lighting.

Apogee Lawns is a certified EverLights dealer and installer serving Lincoln, Omaha, and surrounding Nebraska areas. Our trained technicians handle the entire process—from free consultation and custom design to professional installation—so you never have to climb a ladder or deal with tangled wires again.
##H4## How much do permanent christmas lights cost?

Pricing is customized based on the linear footage of your roofline and the complexity of your home’s architecture. EverLights systems are an investment that eliminates the yearly cost of buying, hanging, and storing traditional lights. Contact Apogee Lawns for a free , no-obligation quote tailored to your Lincoln-area home.
##H4## Can I use the lights year-round or just for holidays?

Yes! EverLights are designed for 365-day use. Customers in Nebraska use them for Christmas, Halloween, 4th of July, Husker gamedays, birthdays, graduation parties, and even simple warm-white accent lighting to make their home look beautiful every evening.
##H4## How do I control the permanent holiday lights?
Everything is controlled through the easy-to-use EverLights app on your smartphone. You can:
Control different zones (e.g., front of house separately from the back)
The system also integrates with Alexa and Google Home for voice control.
##H4## Are the lights durable enough for Nebraska’s weather?

Absolutely. EverLights are IP67-rated waterproof and built to withstand rain, snow, ice, wind, and extreme temperature swings common in Lincoln and Omaha. The LEDs are engineered and tested for long-term outdoor performance in all climates.
##H4## What does the installation process involve?

Our skilled technicians perform a one-time professional installation. Lights are neatly mounted along your eaves (facing outward or downward depending on the look you want). A small wireless receiver and power supplies are installed discreetly (usually in the garage or under an eave). The entire job is completed in one day for most homes, and we’ll show you exactly how to use the app before we leave.
##H4## Do permanent christmas lights require any maintenance?

Maintenance is minimal. The system is designed to last with almost no upkeep. Because the lights are permanently installed and weatherproof, you don’t have to worry about annual setup or storage. If anything ever needs attention (very rare), Apogee Lawns and EverLights provide fast local support and repair service.

EverLights use high-quality, low-power LEDs that consume far less electricity than traditional incandescent holiday lights. You can run beautiful, vibrant displays every night without worrying about high energy bills—perfect for year-round use in Nebraska homes.
##H4## Is there a warranty on the lights and installation?

Yes. EverLights come with a 5-year warranty (including coverage through authorized dealers like Apogee Lawns). The LEDs themselves are rated for up to 50,000 hours of use—equivalent to leaving them on 24/7 for about 7 straight years. We stand behind the product and our professional installation.
